estimator.response: synthetic or future empirical directed T_st
estimator.fixed_effect_absorption: exact source and target fixed effects by solving the bipartite normal equations; one target reference column is omitted only for numerical identification
estimator.covariance: two-way source/target cluster-robust sandwich with dyad intersection subtraction and finite-cluster corrections
estimator.test: one-sided normal upper-tail test for beta_R > 0

synthetic_worlds.seed_rule: uint64 from the first 16 hex characters of SHA256('<seed_namespace>|<design_sha256>|<cell_name>')
synthetic_worlds.private_structure: source-specific slope on z_geographic_coverage and target-specific slope on z_log1p_centroid_distance_km; each slope SD = 0.12 * A

relational_positive_cell.name: host_relation_A3_beta0p03
relational_positive_cell.rationale: A deliberately small positive relation under the strongest frozen private-structure stress; this is a method detection floor, not an expected empirical effect.

gates.private_type1: for every private-null cell, Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate <= 0.10
gates.relational_power: for host_relation_A3_beta0p03, Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate >= 0.80
gates.numerical: all fitted worlds finite and response-blind predictor crossproduct condition number < 1e4

stopping_rules: If any formal Type-I cell fails, do not open nucleotide identity or T_st.
If positive-control power fails, do not open nucleotide identity or T_st.
Do not alter the host relation, controls, effect floor, world generator, alpha, or inference using future empirical genetic response.
A failed qualification is NOT_EVALUABLE and is not evidence against host-conditioned transfer.
